items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 91:1
items.html: The face of Arich Anpin is from the forehead and below, from where the lower seven of the Galgalta begin, which is the aspect of the LAMED of Tzelem and Mocha deAvira, in which the Yud goes out of the air and light remains; hence the face is a part free of hairs, as in Answer 24 above, see there. (Page 341, Item 99; and Page 369, Item 158).
